impact: I cut inference p95 latency from 820 ms to 190 ms at 500 requests per second, measured with k6 on the same hardware, by adding dynamic batching and a response cache to the gateway. [EDIT]

I reduced escaped visual defects by 38% over a quarter of line data by training and shipping a segmentation model with drift monitoring. [EDIT]

about: I started as a backend engineer, building order systems that had to stay correct at peak traffic. That taught me to measure before I optimise, and to design for the retry, the restart and the slow dependency. [EDIT]

At Halden I moved into ML, and found the same lessons apply: a model is only as good as the pipeline that trains, ships and watches it. I now build ML systems and LLM agents end to end, from the evaluation set to the interface people use. [EDIT]
Next, I'm looking for a team where models ship to real users and engineering quality is taken seriously: an SDE, LLM engineer or ML engineer role at a product company. [EDIT]
